body:
This experiment tests whether Jev improves failure correlation, investigation selection, and economic escalation over structured checks and applicable probes. On the controlled pilot, it did not beat that comparator: P0 plus probes resolved 24/24 final actions; P4 retained two false clears. A separate post-hoc five-probe comparison found no P4 allocation advantage, and structured interpretation of existing P3 evidence already produced 24/24 correct actions without further calls.

The branch adds an isolated configurable harness, fresh controlled trajectory variants, stage-specific keys, executable boundary controls, P0–P4 and paired reasoning comparisons, audits, economics, and exact raw evidence. Product code, frozen v1 evidence, and repair PR #6 are unchanged. This is a draft for review, not an adoption or merge recommendation.

- Main source: `9c6d7612e31bb78eb07868b5ac2a046629c5876c`; tree `5313e3a176515e7b160315a56da430fcde63b189`; run `cloud-20261024-01`.
- Evidence publication: `cfa3549490ee9db1c3e6cad918523cd854902e51`; tree `a5d9f1d77aca18c7a5540f22a0b628474fcc878a`.
- Main execution: 103/103 direct `jev-1.14.0` calls, 22 separate native evaluations, 54 probe records and 23 actual acceptance-action executions. Main Jev list-price estimate is $0.022708140; native costs and actual invoices remain unknown.
- Supplement: `supplement-20261024-02`, source `4577eb2c09a211218cfb822f195127d6a8a3f918`, ten new probes, zero model calls. It is explicitly post-hoc, uses a five-call proxy, and discloses candidate/time/cost confounds.
- Validation: 691 local tests plus 172 subtests passed, eight skipped. [Hosted run 40071712425](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/actions/runs/40071712425) passed 871 test/subtest records with no skips. The preceding shallow-history failure and workflow-only correction are retained.
- Keyless replay from relocated archives and tampered-decision rejection passed. A separate within-run reviewer recomputed main and supplemental results.

[Results report](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/cfa3549490ee9db1c3e6cad918523cd854902e51/experiments/jev_failure_correlation_v2/REPORT.md) · [Economics](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/cfa3549490ee9db1c3e6cad918523cd854902e51/experiments/jev_failure_correlation_v2/ECONOMIC-FINDINGS.md) · [E01–E14 mapping](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/cfa3549490ee9db1c3e6cad918523cd854902e51/experiments/jev_failure_correlation_v2/REQUIREMENTS.md) · [Raw archive identities](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/cfa3549490ee9db1c3e6cad918523cd854902e51/experiments/jev_failure_correlation_v2/evidence/archive-index.json) · [Independent-review handoff and replay commands](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/cfa3549490ee9db1c3e6cad918523cd854902e51/experiments/jev_failure_correlation_v2/HANDOFF.md)

Limits: 24 cases are only seven dependency groups; relationships cover one family; structure-extraction costs and production consequences are not measured. Exact native model/effort and billing metadata were not exposed, so that attribution remains unverified. The original random reasoning comparator was degenerate and remains retained alongside the separate supplement. Additional probe gains are confounded with switching to structured interpretation. The owner-requested independent adversarial review remains a separate next session using the supplied handoff. Do not merge.
